description:
💎 CRESENCIA AFFILIATE PROGRAM

Earn. Create. Be part of something beautiful.

At Cresencia, we believe fine jewelry should be worn every day—not saved for special occasions.

Our pieces are designed for the modern woman—whether she’s building her life, raising a family, celebrating milestones, or simply choosing herself.

Now, we’re inviting you to be part of that story.

✨ What is the Cresencia Affiliate Program?

Our affiliate program allows creators, customers, and brand advocates to earn commission by sharing Cresencia.

When someone shops through your unique link or code, you earn a percentage of every sale.

Simple. Transparent. Rewarding.

💰 Commission Structure

  • 10–20% commission per sale (performance-based tiers)

  • 30-day cookie window

  • No cap on earnings

The more you share, the more you earn.

🎁 Your Audience Benefits

  • Exclusive 10% off code

  • Access to limited-time drops & promotions

  • High-quality, giftable jewelry they’ll love

🤍 Why Cresencia?

  • Luxury look, without traditional markups

  • Lab-grown diamonds = accessible fine jewelry

  • Timeless, everyday designs

  • Founder-led brand with real story + emotional connection

🎁 QUARTERLY GIVEAWAYS (CORE DIFFERENTIATOR)

We believe in rewarding the people who grow with us.

Every quarter, we host Cresencia Jewelry Giveaways—and there are 3 ways to win:

1. Customers

Every purchase = automatic entry

2. Social Community

Followers can enter through social campaigns

3. Affiliates

Earn entries through:

  • Content creation

  • Engagement

  • Sales performance

💡 Why this matters

  • More content → more exposure

  • More engagement → more reach

  • More chances → more excitement

You’re not just earning—you’re participating in something bigger.

📦 What You’ll Get

  • Custom affiliate link + discount code

  • Early access to launches

  • Content guidance + creative direction

  • Opportunity for gifting + long-term partnerships

📱 Content That Performs

  • Try-on / styling videos

  • Unboxings

  • Lifestyle content

  • Gifting moments

  • Educational / comparison videos

🚀 Who This Is For

  • Content creators

  • Moms, professionals, lifestyle creators

  • Anyone who loves jewelry

If you love Cresencia, you belong here.

🔗 How to Join

  1. Apply

  2. Get approved

  3. Receive your link + code

  4. Start posting & earning

💬 A Note from the Founder

Cresencia was created to celebrate the woman you are today—not someday.

If you choose to share this brand, you’re helping other women feel confident, seen, and worthy of wearing something beautiful every day.

And that means everything to us.
